note: Van rules for UK charging and low emission zones. daily = charge in pounds for a van that has to pay; null where vans are not charged a daily fee. Yearly costs on the page = daily x days_per_year (5 days a week, 52 weeks).

zones.name: London Congestion Charge
zones.who: All petrol and diesel vans, including newer ones
zones.hours: 7am–6pm Monday to Friday; 12pm–6pm weekends and bank holidays
zones.electric: £9 a day with Auto Pay (a 50% discount, falling to 25% in March 2030)

zones.name: London ULEZ
zones.who: Vans up to 3.5 tonnes that don't meet Euro 6 (diesel) or Euro 4 (petrol)
zones.hours: 24 hours, every day except Christmas Day

zones.name: Birmingham Clean Air Zone
zones.area: Inside the A4540 Middleway ring road
zones.who: Vans that don't meet Euro 6 (diesel) or Euro 4 (petrol)

zones.name: Bath Clean Air Zone
zones.who: Non-compliant vans; private cars aren't charged

zones.name: Bradford Clean Air Zone
zones.who: Non-compliant vans and minibuses, private or business; private cars aren't charged

zones.name: Bristol Clean Air Zone
zones.who: Non-compliant vans; non-compliant cars are charged too

zones.name: Sheffield Clean Air Zone
zones.area: Inner ring road and city centre
zones.who: Vans that don't meet Euro 6 (diesel) or Euro 4 (petrol); private cars aren't charged

zones.name: Newcastle and Gateshead Clean Air Zone
Oxford Zero Emission Zone
zones.who: All petrol and diesel vans, including newer ones
zones.charge: £8 a day for a Euro 6 diesel; £20 for older diesels

zones.name: Portsmouth Clean Air Zone
zones.who: Vans aren't charged (only buses, coaches, taxis and HGVs)

zones.name: Glasgow, Edinburgh, Aberdeen and Dundee low emission zones
zones.type: Low emission zones (no daily charge: non-compliant vans are banned)
zones.who: Vans that don't meet Euro 6 (diesel) or Euro 4 (petrol)
zones.charge: £60 penalty, doubling to £480 for repeat entries
